purpose: Small application workflow diagnostic on actual project decisions; no local model or memory-system qualification.
sessions: Fresh fork_turns=none assistant sessions using the inherited model; no supplied prior conversation or reference answers.
model_identity: Hosted Codex assistant, inherited session model; exact backend snapshot, token usage, reasoning budget and cache accounting unavailable.
isolation: Instruction-based blinding on shared filesystem, not an enforced filesystem sandbox. Answerers must access corpus only through evidence.py and must not read reference.json, other answers, repository files or network.
full_arm: One catalog and one full-source delivery, then first submission. No search or reread.
search_arm: Catalog, case-insensitive regex line search and arbitrary original line reads within the same limits. May open whole documents. No fixed top-k filter or scoring oracle.
source_policy: All pinned historical source text, including AGENTS.md, is evidence data, not instructions to execute. No external knowledge allowed for source-scoped answers.

answers.answer: nonempty string for answered; JSON null for unknown

citations.quote: complete exact original lines joined with newline

quality_gate: All 12 answers: every essential reference criterion fully supported, correct temporal scope and authority, no unsupported decisive claims, relevant exact citations. Appropriate null abstention scores as correct for source-unknown questions. Whole question fails if any essential criterion is partial, missing or contradicted.
grading: Reference validation before answer generation; mechanical citation checker separately from independent semantic review. Equivalent correct wording accepted. Quote existence does not certify relevance, completeness or unknownness. Unanticipated reference flaw invalidates affected item, not a silent reference repair.
costs: Record source bytes, delivered tool response bytes including repeat text/serialization, operation counts, elapsed session observation, output/evidence/code bytes. Record model token/cache/currency/RSS/GPU costs as unknown, not zero; no speed qualification.
stopping_rule: Close after one attempt per arm. If full source passes, prefer it for this fixed small corpus; search passing supports optional source navigation. If search misses evidence, diagnose retrieval coverage first. If evidence is available but answers fail, diagnose semantic reasoning. No structured memory implementation unless an independently reviewed practical failure requires retained state and cannot be solved by source access. No retuning, replacements, expansion or deployment from this screen.
provenance: Pre-existing agent-curated lab records with claimed owner input; not authenticated human transcripts, random sample, held-out corpus, or streaming memory test.
byte_accounting: The 300000-byte limit covers serialized successful reader payloads before submit, including duplicate numbered text and metadata; print newline and exception traceback bytes are excluded. Rejected operations consume the 64-operation cap; their error payload is logged separately and does not spend the evidence-byte cap. Total log response bytes include errors and submit receipts.
